messages.text: Broncos overpower Seahawks to win in OT

metadata.summary: The Denver Broncos overpowered Sam Darnold and the Seattle Seahawks in a 17-14 overtime victory on Thursday night.
metadata.content: Denver Broncos 17-14 Seattle Seahawks (OT): Denver defense overpowers Sam Darnold and defending champions | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Denver Broncos 17-14 Seattle Seahawks (OT): Denver defense overpowers Sam Darnold and defending champions Denver Broncos defense stifles Sam Darnold to win 17-14 in overtime; Darnold was sacked five times and threw two interceptions including a decisive pick in OT; Broncos move to 4-2 and defending champions fall to 3-3 Friday 16 October 2026 06:45, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the Denver Broncos against the Seattle Seahawks from Week 6 of the NFL season The Denver Broncos overpowered Sam Darnold and the Seattle Seahawks in a 17-14 overtime victory on Thursday night. Will Lutz kicked a 53-yard field goal to win it at Mile High Stadium to move Denver to 4-2 and drop the defending champion Seahawks to 3-3. Jags QB Lawrence finally hitting lofty heights expected from No 1 pick Bellingham, United and bedlam - NFL London's greatest moment? Crane was capped three times as a 20-year-old, nine years ago, the last of which was his Test debut in the final match of England's 2017/18 Ashes tour in Sydney. Martinez launched an extraordinary attack on the club's hierarchy after the 2-0 defeat in Spain, as he criticised the lack of summer investment in the squad and said he expected more from "upstairs" after he singled out technical director Jason Wilcox. Sky Sports News understands Martinez met the club's hierarchy, including Wilcox and CEO Omar Berrada, on Thursday. Head coach Michael Carrick was also present at the meeting. messages.text: Garcia set to face Lopez next after emphatic Benn win

metadata.summary: Ryan Garcia is set to face Teofimo Lopez in his next fight after his emphatic victory over Conor Benn last month.
metadata.content: Ryan Garcia set to face US rival Teofimo Lopez next after emphatic victory over Conor Benn | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Ryan Garcia set to face US rival Teofimo Lopez next after emphatic victory over Conor Benn After his spectacular stoppage of Conor Benn, Ryan Garcia is set to face Teofimo Lopez next; Benn is yet to confirm his next career move although he continues to be linked with a trilogy fight against Chris Eubank Jr; Garcia and fellow American Lopez are both welterweight world champions Thursday 15 October 2026 17:12, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Ryan Garcia retained his WBC world title after flooring Conor Benn heavily before forcing a stoppage victory in the second round. Fight footage courtesy of DAZN Ryan Garcia is set to face Teofimo Lopez in his next fight after his emphatic victory over Conor Benn last month. Garcia defended his WBC welterweight title with a second-round stoppage of British contender Benn in Las Vegas and is now holding talks for a fight against Lopez, Sky Sports News understands. Fellow American Lopez also holds a world title in the same division after he sealed a majority decision win over Rolando Romero to claim the WBA belt in August.
